title: Revisiting What Makes a Good Context Subset: A Sparse Latent Basis Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2611.19220v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Selecting context subsets is increasingly important in modern LLM inference, yet what makes a subset effective remains unclear. We study this question in the controlled setting of few-shot demonstration selection. We examine a hypothesis that demonstrations should collectively provide task-relevant information needed by a target query. Assuming that the query representation provides a useful proxy for these requirements, we formulate selection as sparse reconstruction and instantiate it with Residual Explanation Search (RES), a Matching-Pursuit-style diagnostic procedure. Across seven benchmarks and eight open-weight LLMs, no retrieval objective is universally best. RES outperforms MMR in 34 of 56 model--dataset pairs, with its clearest advantage on sentiment tasks, suggesting that query-conditioned collective reconstruction may capture useful complementarity that pairwise dissimilarity misses. Relevance-based retrieval remains strong

translated_title: 重新审视什么构成良好的上下文子集：稀疏潜在基的视角
translated_abstract: 在现代大语言模型推理中，选择上下文子集变得越来越重要，然而是什么使一个子集有效仍不清楚。我们在少样本示例选择的受控环境中研究这一问题。我们检验了一个假设：所选示例应当共同提供目标查询所需的与任务相关的信息。假设查询表示能为这些需求提供有用的代理，我们将选择问题形式化为稀疏重建，并用残差解释搜索（RES）加以实现——这是一种匹配追踪式的诊断程序。在七个基准测试和八个开源权重大语言模型上的实验表明，没有任何检索目标是普遍最优的。RES在56个模型-数据集组合中的34个上优于MMR，其在情感任务上的优势最为明显，这表明以查询为条件的集体重建可能捕获到成对相异性度量所遗漏的有用互补性。而基于相关性的检索仍然表现强劲。
tldr: 该论文将少样本示例选择形式化为以查询表示为目标的稀疏重建问题，提出匹配追踪式的残差解释搜索（RES）方法，实验表明其在多数模型-数据集组合上优于MMR，说明示例的集体互补性比成对相异性更重要。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates few-shot demonstration selection as query-conditioned sparse reconstruction and proposes Residual Explanation Search (RES), a Matching-Pursuit-style method that outperforms MMR in most model-dataset pairs, showing collective complementarity matters more than pairwise dissimilarity.
